text: Supports MUST be drawn before what rests on them.
Face details MUST lie in their face plane, inside the face, away from rounded corners.
Labels MUST sit in side columns at least 13 apart and NEVER overlap.
Leader lines NEVER cross another solid without a written justification.
Shapes and label text MUST stay inside the viewBox.
Every fill and stroke MUST be var(--...), none or url(#...); NEVER a raw colour.
Every animation MUST stop under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Motion MUST move along one iso axis and NEVER lift in z while resting.
A figure MUST explain exactly one idea with one concrete object.
checklist: The idea is stated in one sentence and the object is a concrete thing a reader can picture.

text: Motion MUST tell one story and the still frame MUST explain the idea alone.
checklist: Motion tells one looping story and the reduced-motion still frame still explains the idea.

text: Copy MUST be one idea per sentence and NEVER claim facts the page does not keep true.
checklist: Labels are a few words, captions one or two sentences, and no self-unmaintained claims appear.

text: The page MUST work in light and dark, at 390px with no horizontal scroll, with no console errors.
checklist: Screenshots in light, dark and 390px show no horizontal scroll and the console is clean.

text: Dots MUST carry meaning and be named in a label or the copy; NEVER decorate solids.
checklist: Every dot on a solid is named in a label or the copy.
